About

I’m a product manager at Carrier working on digital experiences for residential digital climate solutions, where I sit at the intersection of product, technology, analytics, and go-to-market strategy.

What excites me most is using technology to solve meaningful, real-world problems. I’m especially drawn to products that use data, AI, and connected technologies to make complex experiences simpler, smarter, and more accessible for the people who use them.

My background in computer science, business, and marketing strategy shapes how I approach products end to end: understanding the technology, uncovering customer insights, defining the experience, and crafting the messaging that drives adoption.

I studied Computer Science with a Business minor at UIUC and am finishing my master’s in Marketing and Strategy at Santa Clara University. I’m currently based between the San Francisco Bay Area and Atlanta, and I’m open to opportunities anywhere in the U.S.

Selected work

Carrier

Product Manager, Digital Products & Experiences · 2026 to now

I'm a product manager on the Service Tech App, the app HVAC technicians use in the field. It's one half of a connected journey with the Smart Home App, which homeowners use. Together they keep service proactive instead of reactive, so nobody has to wait for something bad to happen.

Proactive, not reactive

  1. Stay connectedInteliSense™ technology shares system health data from connected equipment.
  2. Spot it earlyMachine learning and critical alerts flag issues before they turn into breakdowns.
  3. Everyone knowsHomeowners get the alert. Technicians see the same system details in the Service Tech App.
  4. A smoother visitTechnicians arrive prepared, so more issues get fixed on the first visit.
  • Shared features. I partner with the Smart Home App team to build features that work across both apps, like critical alerts that keep homeowners informed and smart grid capabilities, so homeowners and technicians are working from the same picture.
  • My focus. Product analytics and growth. I work with engineering to instrument the app, so we can see how technicians use it and where to improve it.
  • AI and dashboards. Using Cursor and Claude Code, I built a dashboard and engineered an AI assistant for product analytics. I created an MCP that connects Bitbucket and LogRocket, our product analytics platform, so the team can ask questions about how the app is used.
  • Campaigns. I track campaign performance in Google Analytics.

Marketing connected devices

I also help market edge connectivity devices inside the Service Tech App. I wrote product FAQs and flyers for Carrier's smart thermostat line with InteliSense™, explaining what information the thermostats give homeowners and technicians.

For homeowners

The thermostat learns your schedule and comfort preferences, adjusts for local weather, and shares monthly energy insights and how your system is performing.

For dealers and technicians

With InteliSense-enabled Performance™ Series equipment and data sharing turned on, dealers can remotely monitor system health and use digital tools for faster service, including remote troubleshooting.

Sendbird

Product Strategy & Marketing Intern · 2026

Internship

Delight.ai is Sendbird's AI concierge that lets a brand run one AI agent across chat, voice, SMS, email, and social. It launched in November 2025, and I supported go-to-market and strategy for it from the ground up.

What I did

Strategy
Competitive analysis and go-to-market support for the launch.
Battlecards
Used Claude Code and MCP to build a battlecard generator that is shared across the organization. Battlecards are short sales guides that compare us with competitors.
Content
Blog posts and industry solution, competitor comparison, and product pages.
Launches
Supported the Agent Memory and Agent Steward launches, and worked with product and engineering on voice testing.
Measurement
Tracked campaign performance (clicks, including e-commerce) and keyword rankings, analyzed Gong sales calls, and updated product FAQs.

Motorola Solutions

Technical Product Manager Intern · 2024 to 2025

Internship

I worked on three projects across Motorola Solutions' critical communications software.

Critical Connect

Motorola's public safety platform for connecting different devices, like radios and landline phones. I redesigned the onboarding workflow and updated the app's UI so new and existing users can provision and connect their devices more easily.

MC-Edge and Orchestrate

Orchestrate is Motorola's public safety software platform for creating triggers and alerts for emergency events. I used firmware and telemetry data from MC-Edge to make those triggers more specific, with signals like temperature and whether a door is open or unlocked.

Product portal assistant

A customer service AI assistant that helps users provision new Motorola Solutions products, across Orchestrate, MOTOTRBO, and MOTOTRBO Next.

Beyond work

I'm really into aesthetics. I keep Pinterest boards full of ideas, and I love creating things. Lately that means making collages and posters for friends and family, each one built around what that person loves.
